verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS recruiting platform like Dover, so the axis applies. The pack has no documentation of a telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking opt-out. Muting job email notifications and the optional applicant EEO survey are different controls and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
